title: HDB Flats with Annual Value of $13,000 or More
what_it_is: HDB Flats with Annual Value of $13,000 or More

sections.label: HDB flats annual value thresholds
sections.summary: About 430,000 HDB flats have AV of $13,000 or more, including about 36,000 resident households with zero monthly household income from work, and MOF is reviewing AV thresholds.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: As a result, there are now about 430,000 or about 40% of HDB flats with AV of $13,000 or more.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Based on estimates from the Department of Statistics, about 36,000 resident households with zero monthly household income from work, live in HDB flats with AV of $13,000 or more.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: MOF had also mentioned that we are reviewing the AV thresholds to ensure that Singaporeans in need are able to receive the appropriate support.
